okx_window_trimming_preserved.note: A retained source row at or after 2025-01-01 raises PROTECTED_YEAR_ROW_IN_RETAINED_SOURCE. This is structural protection, not outcome inspection.

L10.defect: The permit's arm_commit defaulted to HEAD and verify_execution_reservation() then read the reservation from permit.arm_commit, so a normal F -> A -> R lifecycle was impossible: the ARM and reservation had to occupy the same commit.
L10.repair: Reservation-first resolution. verify_execution_reservation_from_commit(R) reads the tracked reservation from R, extracts arm_commit A, authenticates the ARM at exactly A, and requires A to be an ancestor of R. verify_execution_arm() now refuses when no arm_commit is supplied (MARKET_06_ARM_COMMIT_REQUIRED) instead of searching HEAD. No artifact contains its own commit SHA; SELF_REFERENTIAL_FIELDS are rejected.

L11_claim.defect: A local filesystem lock was the only guard before science. A crash between outcome computation and RESULT persistence silently returned the one shot.
L11_claim.repair: Durable tracked CLAIM is now the consumption point and must exist before any market data is parsed. verify_claim_from_commit(C) resolves C -> R -> A -> F. A local append-only attempt ledger is fsynced before reconstruction and is never rolled back on failure, so a second attempt refuses with MARKET_06_CANONICAL_RUN_ALREADY_CLAIMED even when no RESULT exists. assert_claim_creatable refuses a second claim for the same run identity.

L11_result.repair: market_06_result_persistence builds a deterministic canonical RESULT bound to research_id, run_identity, claim/reservation/ARM commits, implementation freeze, prereg freeze, dataset/snapshot/durable root, classification, gates, prereg metrics, eligible support, reconstruction audit and bootstrap constants. Canonical JSON (sort_keys, allow_nan=False, 2-space indent, trailing newline) defines RESULT_PAYLOAD_SHA256. Clock/uuid/host/pid/user/path fields are rejected, so identical science yields identical bytes. Staging writes only the frozen target paths and never commits.

L12.defect: reconstruct_canonical_dataset accepted source_commit, letting a caller point canonical reconstruction at any commit whose manifest merely copied the expected identity strings.
L12.repair: The parameter is removed. Canonical raw bytes come only from CANONICAL_DATA_SOURCE_COMMIT = e2d543eadb5425473b6d4b8d24c177c1d7ae7930 (the frozen prereg freeze). Any source_commit/source_ref/data_commit/dataset_commit/path keyword raises MARKET_06_DATA_SOURCE_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN.
